title: Six Days' Campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Six Days' Campaign", at revision 1370747279, opens: "The Six Days' Campaign was a final series of victories by the forces of Napoleon I of France as the Sixth Coalition closed in on Paris. As was said by his contemporary enemy, the Austrian general Johann von Nostitz-Rieneck, this campaign demonstrated Napoleon's tactical mastery "to the highest degree." The campaign occurred during the campaign in north-east France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1034344, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1814 campaign during the War of the Sixth Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
